ingestFilesDescription: Copy or move files into a configured ingest folder. Feylore will recursively discover them, identify content, and process them in the background.
uploadHint: Upload a small number of files from this computer. Files enter the same ingestion pipeline and continue processing after you leave this page.
uploadLimits: Browser upload limit: up to {{files}} files, {{size}} each.
uploadQueued: Files handed to the server. Processing continues in the background.
activityDescription: Processing status is stored on the server and remains available after you refresh or restart.
librariesSettingsDescription: Libraries are where managed content lives after ingestion. Library scan indexes existing files in place without moving them.
ingestSettingsDescription: Drop files anywhere inside an ingest folder. Nested directories are supported. Feylore watches recursively and queues discovered files for background processing.
processingSettingsDescription: Ingestion runs in the background worker. Upload limits apply only to browser uploads, not filesystem ingest.
